title: Horizon Zero Dawn
japaneseTitle: ホライゾン ゼロ ドーン
shortDescription: Guerrilla Games' dazzling open-world sci-fi adventure following outcast hunter Aloy across a post-post-apocalyptic Earth ruled by animalistic machines.
historicalSignificance: Established Guerrilla's proprietary Decima Engine as one of the industry's premier open-world rendering platforms, spawning an iconic new PlayStation mascot in Aloy and selling over 24 million units.

editorialContent.overview: Departing from the grim corridor shooting of Killzone, Guerrilla Games crafted a lush, vibrant post-apocalyptic Earth where nature has reclaimed towering skyscraper ruins and mechanical beasts roam the wilderness like wildlife.
editorialContent.gameplay: Dynamic tactical archery emphasizing component targeting—players tear off radar dishes, weapon pods, and fuel cells using specialized tripwires, ropecasters, and elemental arrows.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Showcased the Decima Engine's groundbreaking procedural foliage, weather systems, and sophisticated robotic joint IK animations.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Aloy instantly became a premier modern video game heroine, recognized for her intelligence, resilience, and curiosity.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on PS4 physical disc, enhanced for PS4 Pro/PS5, and released on PC and PS5 Remastered.

awards: BAFTA Games Award for Original Property
Writers Guild of America Award for Video Game Writing
